content_html_sanitized:
Source: http://reneeboje.com

Posted October 13, 2000
From http://reneeboje.com
Drug War refugee, Renee Boje, faces a 10 year mandatory minimum in a federal prison for medical marijuana charges!
See
The Murder of Peter McWilliams -- An Indictment, Not an Obituary – by Richard Cowan

The public has one last chance to send a letter to the Canadian Minister of Justice, Ann McLellan asking her not to extradite Renee back to DEAland, but to grant her refugee status in Canada, instead.

Deadline for submissions is this Sunday, October 15th. Act Now!

Be very polite

, but tell Justice Minister, Ann McLellan how unjust it would be to send Renee to a DEAland prison.

You may email your letter to: mclellan.a@parl.gc.ca. Be sure to copy your email to Renee at rboje@hotmail.com, and her lawyer, John Conroy at jconroy@johnconroy.com.

You may also mail your letter to:

Renee Boje, PO Box 1557, Gibsons, BC, V0N1V0 and she will forward it to the Justice Minister for you.

Letters which are post marked by Saturday, October 14th, will still be accepted.


To learn more about the case see Renee’s website http://reneeboje.com

Also, for an article by Dan Gardner, the author of the great Ottawa Citizen series on the Drug War, which explains Renee's case in greater detail, See American faces 10 years in jail for tending plants

Be sure and log on to www.pot-tv.net for the 420 MarijuanaNews with Richard Cowan weekdays at 4:20PM Pacific time. If you miss any broadcasts, they are now available in the Archives.
